objectives.description: Compose identity, location, possession, ability, requests and simple instructions.

Education closure: institution/room, course/lesson/content unit/subject, teacher/pupil/peer, schedule, test/result boundary, study/learn/teach/understand/recall, classroom instruction targets, writing/reference materials and shared furniture each have explicit contrasts. Grade/result/credential and institutional-procedure scopes have genuine later or inapplicable dispositions rather than one token per broad category.

Work closure: identify role and workplace, say whether one works or is unemployed, identify work time and holidays, and reuse the hard-working trait. Existing pay/employee/job/earning meanings and every immediate B1 work expansion/planned input are preserved with later or cross-level proposals. Contractual/legal detail is outside A1 identity scope, not outside the overall later catalog.

Technology/science closure: identify computer/tablet/phone and screen/input/audio/power parts, distinguish internet/page/email system from device/message/address, and account for immediate actions and functioning. Program/file/password/attachment/printer meanings are proposed later.
